debit_negative_balances.description: A Boolean indicating if Stripe should try to reclaim negative balances from an attached bank account. See [Understanding Connect account balances](/connect/account-balances) for details. The default value is `false` when [controller.requirement_collection](/api/accounts/object#account_object-controller-requirement_collection) is `application`, which includes Custom accounts, otherwise `true`.

payouts.description: Settings specific to the account's payouts.
